title: The Besieged Khalsa Hears Jassa Singh Seek Reunion

blocks.text: The siege tightens as the attackers reduce the remaining openings around Ram Rauni and try to shut every avenue of relief. The defenders understand that the Mughals blocked every entrance, yet their answer is not surrender but a renewed resolve to die fighting if no other path remains.

At that moment the page introduces an important reconciliation. News arrives that Jassa Singh and the men once estranged from the Khalsa now want reunion with the Panth and wish to share the same danger instead of remaining apart from the besieged Singhs.

The request matters because Ram Rauni is becoming a place where old divisions are burned away by common peril. The fort gathers not only fighters under attack but also scattered Sikh loyalties that are being pulled back into one body.
